mapper.select: SELECT A.APPR_ID AS apprId, A.BIZ_TYPE AS bizType, A.BIZ_ID AS bizId, A.LINE_TYPE AS lineType, LC.CODE_NM AS lineTypeNm, A.STEP_NO AS stepNo, A.SORT_NO AS sortNo, A.ASSIGNEE_ID AS assigneeId, U.USER_NM AS assigneeNm, U.DEPT_NM AS assigneeDept, A.STATUS AS status, SC.CODE_NM AS statusNm, A.OPINION AS opinion, TO_CHAR(A.ACT_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS actDt, A.REG_ID AS regId, TO_CHAR(A.REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS regDt FROM OPS_APPR_LINE A LEFT JOIN OPS_USER U ON U.USER_ID = A.ASSIGNEE_ID LEFT JOIN OPS_CODE LC ON LC.CODE_GRP = 'LINE_TYPE' AND LC.CODE_ID = A.LINE_TYPE LEFT JOIN OPS_CODE SC ON SC.CODE_GRP = 'APPR_STATUS' AND SC.CODE_ID = A.STATUS WHERE A.BIZ_TYPE = #{bizType} AND A.BIZ_ID = #{bizId} ORDER BY A.STEP_NO, A.SORT_NO, A.APPR_ID

SELECT A.APPR_ID AS apprId, A.BIZ_TYPE AS bizType, A.BIZ_ID AS bizId, A.LINE_TYPE AS lineType, A.STEP_NO AS stepNo, A.SORT_NO AS sortNo, A.ASSIGNEE_ID AS assigneeId, A.STATUS AS status, A.OPINION AS opinion FROM OPS_APPR_LINE A WHERE A.APPR_ID = #{apprId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO OPS_APPR_LINE (BIZ_TYPE, BIZ_ID, LINE_TYPE, STEP_NO, SORT_NO, ASSIGNEE_ID, STATUS, OPINION, REG_ID, REG_DT) VALUES (#{bizType}, #{bizId}, #{lineType}, #{stepNo}, #{sortNo}, #{assigneeId}, #{status}, #{opinion}, #{regId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE OPS_APPR_LINE SET STATUS = #{status}, OPINION = #{opinion}, ACT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE APPR_ID = #{apprId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO OPS_CHANGE_CAB (CHG_ID, DECISION, OPINION, REVIEWER, CAB_DT) VALUES (#{chgId}, #{decision}, #{opinion}, #{reviewer}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT S.SHARE_ID AS shareId, S.BIZ_TYPE AS bizType, S.BIZ_ID AS bizId, S.USER_ID AS userId, U.USER_NM AS userNm, U.DEPT_NM AS userDept, S.SHARE_MEMO AS shareMemo, S.READ_AT AS readAt, S.SHARED_BY AS sharedBy, B.USER_NM AS sharedByNm, TO_CHAR(S.SHARED_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS sharedDt FROM OPS_SHARE S LEFT JOIN OPS_USER U ON U.USER_ID = S.USER_ID LEFT JOIN OPS_USER B ON B.USER_ID = S.SHARED_BY WHERE S.BIZ_TYPE = #{bizType} AND S.BIZ_ID = #{bizId} ORDER BY S.SHARED_DT DESC, S.SHARE_ID DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO OPS_SHARE (BIZ_TYPE, BIZ_ID, USER_ID, SHARE_MEMO, READ_AT, SHARED_BY, SHARED_DT) VALUES (#{bizType}, #{bizId}, #{userId}, #{shareMemo}, 'N', #{sharedBy}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT S.SHARE_ID AS shareId, S.BIZ_TYPE AS bizType, S.BIZ_ID AS bizId, S.USER_ID AS userId, S.SHARE_MEMO AS shareMemo, S.READ_AT AS readAt, S.SHARED_BY AS sharedBy, B.USER_NM AS sharedByNm, TO_CHAR(S.SHARED_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS sharedDt FROM OPS_SHARE S LEFT JOIN OPS_USER B ON B.USER_ID = S.SHARED_BY WHERE S.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY S.SHARED_DT DESC, S.SHARE_ID DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM OPS_SHARE WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND READ_AT = 'N'
SELECT USER_ID AS userId, USER_NM AS userNm, ROLE AS role, DEPT_NM AS deptNm FROM OPS_USER WHERE USE_AT = 'Y' ORDER BY CASE ROLE WHEN 'ADMIN' THEN 1 WHEN 'OPERATOR' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, USER_NM
SELECT DEPT_NM FROM OPS_DEPT WHERE USE_AT = 'Y' AND DEPT_NM IS NOT NULL ORDER BY SORT_ORDR, DEPT_ID
SELECT USER_ID FROM OPS_USER WHERE USE_AT = 'Y' AND DEPT_NM = #{deptNm} ORDER BY USER_ID
SELECT USER_ID FROM OPS_USER WHERE USE_AT = 'Y' ORDER BY USER_ID

SELECT T.TPL_ID AS tplId, T.BIZ_TYPE AS bizType, T.KIND AS kind, T.LINE_TYPE AS lineType, LC.CODE_NM AS lineTypeNm, T.STEP_NO AS stepNo, T.SORT_NO AS sortNo, T.TARGET_TYPE AS targetType, TC.CODE_NM AS targetTypeNm, T.TARGET_VALUE AS targetValue, T.MEMO AS memo FROM OPS_APPR_TEMPLATE T LEFT JOIN OPS_CODE LC ON LC.CODE_GRP = 'LINE_TYPE' AND LC.CODE_ID = T.LINE_TYPE LEFT JOIN OPS_CODE TC ON TC.CODE_GRP = 'TARGET_TYPE' AND TC.CODE_ID = T.TARGET_TYPE WHERE T.BIZ_TYPE = #{bizType} ORDER BY T.KIND DESC, T.STEP_NO, T.SORT_NO, T.TPL_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO OPS_APPR_TEMPLATE (BIZ_TYPE, KIND, LINE_TYPE, STEP_NO, SORT_NO, TARGET_TYPE, TARGET_VALUE, MEMO, REG_DT) VALUES (#{bizType}, #{kind}, #{lineType}, #{stepNo}, #{sortNo}, #{targetType}, #{targetValue}, #{memo}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
